bennet_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_dialogue.text: Been a while since I've seen you Bennet, what are you having tonight?

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_dialogue.text: Yeah, it has been. Just the usual please.

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_dialogue.text: How's the business going by the way?

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_dialogue.text: There isn't a lack of clients but my hands aren't as steady as they used to be.

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_dialogue.text: I'm going to have to close down the workshop im afraid.

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_dialogue.text: I'm quite sorry to hear that, who's gonna help me when I get locked out now?

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_dialogue.text: Oh I'm sure there's plenty of reputable locksmiths around here Opal, I'm sure you'll find someone capable.

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_dialogue.text: Have that last drink on the house, we're about to close out for the night.

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_dialogue.text: You have a nice night now.

locked_door.speaker: Opal
locked_door.text: Goddamn it, forgot the key again.

grabbed_keys.speaker: Opal
grabbed_keys.text: There you are, gotta stop forgetting these...

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene.text: That little Vial of yours is really annoying you know?

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene.text: You never let me hang around anymore.

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene.text: And why do you think that is?

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene.text: The one day that I sleep well and you show up immediately.

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene.text: Well you did need it… You look way worse than usual ;)
